explanation: The invasion's own lead makes the assault on Seoul its object and its result in one movement: North Korean forces "launched the blitzkrieg by crossing the 38th parallel north and swarming South Korea at 04:00", and "rushed to encircle and eventually capture Seoul, the capital of South Korea, from the ROK within a week"; the next paragraph closes it — "the DPRK captured Seoul within three days on 28 June". Caused and not precondition-of: the article does not say the invasion made the fight for Seoul possible, it says the invasion was the drive on Seoul. Probable: Wikipedia alone, which rule 22 will not let stand as consensus.
